title: Dynasty Warriors 2 arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2000, Dynasty Warriors 2 became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2000, Dynasty Warriors 2 became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the action and adventure category, Dynasty Warriors 2 broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
